Dear Mr. Nihar Manoj Chaudhari:
Congratulations!  It  is  my  pleasure  to  inform  you  that  you  have  been  admitted  to  the  highly  selective  full-time 
Master’s  program  in  Computer  Science  with  a  concentration  in  Data  Science  &  Engineering  at  Stony  Brook 
University for the Fall semester of 2026. To accept this offer, please follow the directions on the second page of this 
letter. This offer is contingent upon the successful completion of any current academic coursework and receipt of 
all final official transcripts. Please be sure to arrange for your final transcripts to be sent to the Graduate School 
Office of Admissions and Student Services.

Proficiency Course Requirements. We normally admit only those students that have a full undergraduate-level 
background in Computer Science, but in recognition of your unusual strengths, we have made an exception. In order 
to acquire the missing background, you will be required to take the following bridge (or undergraduate) courses in 
order to be cleared for graduation with an MS degree. Note that these requirements are over and above our normal 
MS degree requirements.
•Programming Languages or Compilers
Subject to certain conditions, our MS program permits students to take specially designated bridge courses (CSE 
58x) and some undergraduate courses as proficiency requirement (CSE 587). Based on your

Graduate Student Handbook.

Admissions Enrollment Checklist.
1.  Confirm your enrollment in the Stony Brook Applicant Portal.
2.  Complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) as soon as possible.  You can complete this
form  on-line  athttps://studentaid.gov/h/apply-for-aid/fafsaStony  Brook  Universitys
federal school code is 002838.
3.  For information regarding tuition and fees, please visit Student Financial Services athttps://www.stonybrook.
edu/commcms/sfs.
4.  If you are seeking on-campus housing, you may pay your housing deposit through SOLAR. Paying the housing
deposit in SOLAR does not require matriculation nor NetID. Additional information regarding deadlines and
on-campus housing can be found athttps://www.stonybrook.edu/commcms/studentaffairs/
res/.
5.  For assistance with off-campus housing, please contact the Office of Commuter Student Services and Off-
Campus Living at commuterservices@stonybrook.edu or visithttps://www.stonybrook.edu/commcms/

doc_1793052015396_osfhf_chunk_8.text:
Campus Living at commuterservices@stonybrook.edu or visithttps://www.stonybrook.edu/commcms/
studentaffairs/css/Renting-Off-Campus/.
6.  If you are an international student, you will soon receive your I-20 information and DS-2019 with specific de-
tails about your immigration documents from Visa and Immigration Serviceshttps://www.stonybrook.
edu/commcms/visa/.
7.  For  information  regarding  immunization  and  health  records,  visit  Immunization  Requirements  or  Student
Health Services (stonybrook.edu).  Failure to adhere to or complete either of these requirements will lead to
registration implications.
8.  Arrange for final official transcripts, including current semester grades and degree earned (if applicable), to

may be sent to gradadmissions@stonybrook.edu.
